row.team_price_text: Usage-based (e.g. U.S. 10DLC SMS $0.004 per message); full pricing on request
row.evidence: Bandwidth's SSO integration for the Bandwidth App is free and works with any SAML 2.0 IdP for existing users with email usernames; no SCIM endpoint is documented in the help centre or developer docs, and users are managed through the User Management API.
row.notes: New row. Bandwidth is a usage-priced CPaaS (per message, per minute), so plan and per-user price fields are null. SAML SSO for the Bandwidth App is free on every account and configured by admins; the guide requires users to already exist with email-format usernames, and no JIT is described. No SCIM: status 'none' by absence (rule 5). The User Management API (credential with ACCOUNT_ADMIN scope) lists, creates and updates users, sets status to ACTIVE, SUSPENDED or DEPROVISIONED, and assigns roles and accounts; there is no DELETE user call. An Audit Log API (Audit Log Viewer role) returns account events.

plans.name: Usage-based (volume pricing)
plans.price_text: U.S. 10DLC SMS $0.004 per message, MMS $0.015 per message; full pricing on request
plans.notes: No seat-based plans; SSO is free for all Bandwidth App accounts.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint is documented. The help centre search for 'scim' returns no articles, the developer docs index (llms.txt) has no SCIM page, and SSO is SAML-only for pre-existing Bandwidth App users. Status 'none' by absence.

auth.notes: The reference lists Bearer authorization on every call; ACCOUNT_ADMIN is an account scope on the API credential, not an OAuth scope string. oauth2 is inferred from Bearer tokens issued to API credentials and is not separately cited.

endpoints.purpose: Create a user (accounts, roles, accountScope required)
Update a user, including status ACTIVE / SUSPENDED / DEPROVISIONED
List a user's audit log events (last 60 days)
List accounts to assign to users
List account audit log events (Audit Log API)

audit_log_api.notes: Account events via the Audit Log API (Audit Log Viewer role); per-user audit logs and async reports in the User Management API (last 60 days).

limitations.text: Updating roles or accounts overwrites the existing values rather than appending.

okta.notes: OIN search for 'bandwidth' returns no results; Bandwidth's guide uses a custom SAML 2.0 app.

entra.notes: No Bandwidth entry in the Entra saas-apps index (toc.json).

fallbacks.notes: The SSO guide requires users to exist before SSO (non-email usernames must be recreated), so no JIT is described; the docs do not say 'no JIT' outright.
